# tabd

SSH-friendly single-binary Rust browser automation CLI — daemon-shared Chromium over CDP.

## Documentation

- User-facing references (shipped inside the binary by `tabd skill install`):
  `.claude/skills/tabd/{SKILL,commands,cookbook,operations,architecture}.md`
- Contributor docs (design drafts, phase-plan history) live in the private SSoT (`~/docs`), not in this repo:
  `~/docs/repo-docs/tabd/` — surfaced here as the `docs/` symlink. Start at `docs/INDEX.md`.
- SSoT topic note (why/history/cross-links): `~/docs/topics/repos/tabd.md`

The `docs/` directory in this repo is a symlink into `~/docs/repo-docs/tabd` and is
gitignored here; those files are tracked only in the `~/docs` repo.
